#include <cmath>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    long long a, b, n;
    cin >> a >> b >> n;
    long long min_diff = 1000000000LL;
    long long best_x = 0, best_y = 0;
    for (long long y = 1; y <= n; y++) {
        long long x_approx = (a * y) / b;
        for (long long delta = -5; delta <= 5; delta++) {
            long long candidate_x = x_approx + delta;
            long long diff = abs(b * candidate_x - a * y);
            if (diff * 1LL * 1000000000LL < min_diff * b * y) {
                min_diff = diff;
                best_x = candidate_x;
                best_y = y;
            }
        }
    }
    cout << best_x << '/' << best_y;
    return 0;
}
